issues.title: Home/Weather screen missing all accessibility attributes
evidence: Lines 1-230: No accessibilityRole, accessibilityLabel, or accessible props
MetricTile components render without screen reader support
Title 'Current Conditions' has no header role
issues.whyItMatters: Users with visual impairments cannot understand current weather conditions—the core value prop of the app. VoiceOver/TalkBack users will hear nothing meaningful.
issues.recommendedFix: Add accessibilityRole='header' to title, accessibilityLabel to all MetricTile instances with full context (e.g., 'Temperature 72 degrees Fahrenheit'). Consider wrapping metrics in accessible region.
acceptanceCriteria: Screen title announced as header by VoiceOver/TalkBack
Each metric tile announces label, value, and unit
Loading state announces 'Loading conditions' to screen readers

issues.title: ResultCard component missing accessibility labels
evidence: Lines 70-200: Component accepts onPress but lacks accessibilityRole='button'
primaryValue rendered without accessibilityLabel combining context
No announcement of 'Plays like 168 yards' result
issues.whyItMatters: The main 'Plays like' recommendation is the most critical piece of information in the app and is completely invisible to assistive technologies.
issues.recommendedFix: Add accessibilityLabel prop that combines primaryLabel, primaryValue, and primaryUnit. Add accessibilityRole='button' when onPress is provided. Add accessibilityState for pressed state.
acceptanceCriteria: Screen readers announce 'Plays like 168 yards' as a complete phrase
Interactive cards are announced as buttons
Secondary/tertiary values included in accessibility tree

issues.title: Hardcoded color values in WindDirectionCompass
evidence: Line 214: '#22C55E' hardcoded in gradient array for locked state
Line 273: '#000' used as fallback shadow color instead of token
issues.whyItMatters: Hardcoded colors break theme consistency and may reduce outdoor readability in light mode. The design system expects all colors to come from tokens.
issues.recommendedFix: Replace '#22C55E' with tokens.colors.success (which equals '#22C55E' in dark mode). Replace '#000' with tokens.colors.shadow for consistent theming.
acceptanceCriteria: No hardcoded hex colors in component
Compass renders correctly in both light and dark modes
Locked state uses semantic success color from tokens

issues.title: ConditionChip accessibility label missing metric context
evidence: Lines 200-220: ConditionChip accessibilityLabel only contains value
accessibilityLabel={`${value}`} without label context
Users hear '68°F' without knowing it's temperature
issues.whyItMatters: Screen reader users hear raw values without understanding what metric they represent, making the conditions bar useless for accessibility.
issues.recommendedFix: Update accessibilityLabel to include the metric type. Pattern: accessibilityLabel={`${label}: ${value}`} or derive label from icon type.
acceptanceCriteria: Each chip announces 'Temperature: 68°F' or similar
All four condition metrics (density, altitude, temp, humidity) have context
Icons are marked accessibilityElementsHidden={true}

issues.title: No accessibilityHint for complex interactions
evidence: Slider increment/decrement buttons have accessibilityLabel but no hint
GlassCard with onPress lacks guidance on expected action
Button component doesn't pass through accessibilityHint
issues.whyItMatters: Users need guidance on what will happen when they interact with unfamiliar controls. Hints like 'Double tap to increase by 1' improve discoverability.
issues.recommendedFix: Add accessibilityHint props to Slider buttons ('Double tap to decrease value'), GlassCard ('Double tap to view details'), and expose accessibilityHint in Button props.
acceptanceCriteria: Slider +/- buttons announce their action on focus
Pressable GlassCards hint at navigation or action
accessibilityHint prop available on Button component

issues.title: FlatList used instead of FlashList in OnboardingFlow
evidence: Line 36: import { FlatList } from 'react-native'
Line 371-374: Standard FlatList used for step carousel
No estimatedItemSize optimization
issues.whyItMatters: FlashList is 5x faster for list rendering. Onboarding contains animated content and multiple steps that would benefit from the optimization.
issues.recommendedFix: Replace FlatList with @shopify/flash-list FlashList. Add estimatedItemSize prop based on screen width. Keep horizontal and pagingEnabled props.
acceptanceCriteria: FlashList imported from @shopify/flash-list
estimatedItemSize prop set to screen width
Onboarding scroll performance improved on low-end devices

issues.title: ErrorBoundary retry button missing accessibility feedback
evidence: Lines 140-145: Pressable button lacks accessibilityRole
No accessibilityState for loading during recovery
Button text 'Try Again' not descriptive enough
issues.whyItMatters: Error recovery is a critical path. Users need clear feedback on what the button does and whether recovery is in progress.
issues.recommendedFix: Add accessibilityRole='button', accessibilityLabel='Try again to reload the app', and consider adding loading state with accessibilityState={{ busy: isRecovering }}.
acceptanceCriteria: Button announced as 'Try again to reload the app, button'
Loading state announced during cache clear
Error message accessible to screen readers

issues.title: Input component lacks error state styling
evidence: Component only has focused/unfocused states
No 'error' prop or red border styling
No accessibilityLabelledBy for error messages
issues.whyItMatters: Golf club distance inputs need validation feedback. Users entering invalid yardage (e.g., 9999) get no visual or accessible indication of the error.
issues.recommendedFix: Add error prop with boolean type. When true, show danger border color from tokens. Add accessibilityInvalid={error} and aria-describedby pattern for error text.
acceptanceCriteria: Input shows red border when error prop is true
accessibilityInvalid reflects error state
Error message linked via accessibilityLabelledBy

issues.title: Tab bar icons missing explicit accessibilityState
evidence: Lines 30-45: TabBarIcon doesn't set accessibilityState
Expo Router may handle selection, but explicit is safer
No visual indication beyond color change
issues.whyItMatters: Ensures consistent behavior across Android TalkBack and iOS VoiceOver. Explicit accessibility state is more reliable than framework inference.
issues.recommendedFix: Wrap TabBarIcon in View with accessibilityState={{ selected: focused }}. Consider adding accessibilityLabel with tab name and selection state.
acceptanceCriteria: Tab icons announce 'Shot tab, selected' when focused
Unselected tabs announce 'Wind tab, not selected'
Works consistently on iOS and Android

issues.title: Compass lock announcements lack wind context
evidence: Lines 115-120: announceForAccessibility only says 'Compass locked/unlocked'
Wind direction and relationship not included
Missing speed and heading context
issues.whyItMatters: Blind users need the full wind context announced when locking the compass. The current announcement doesn't convey the critical information.
issues.recommendedFix: Enhance announcement to include full context: 'Compass locked. Wind is headwind at 15 mph from 270 degrees.' Use windRelationship variable already computed.
acceptanceCriteria: Lock announcement includes wind relationship (headwind/tailwind/crosswind)
Wind speed included in announcement
Unlock announcement confirms current heading
